name: Proofpoint / Zscaler
xql_query:
dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
| filter _log_type = "click-permitted"
| fields clickIP, senderIP, recipient, url, GUID, _time as pp_time
| join (
    dataset = zscaler_nssweblog_raw
    | filter act = "Block"
    | fields src as zs_src, dhost, request as blocked_url,
             cat as threat_cat, reason, cn1 as threat_score,
             suser, _time as zs_time) as zs
  clickIP = zs.zs_src
| filter zs_time >= pp_time
| fields recipient, clickIP, url as phish_url, GUID, pp_time,
         dhost, blocked_url, threat_cat, reason, threat_score, suser, zs_time
